headline: Difficulty testing adds a sparse emergency Hammer comparison

changes.title: Exercise minimal booster use in the automated player
changes.detail: The 1,000-stage greedy playtest keeps its original no-booster results and adds a same-seed rescue run on every fifth level. The test bot may use at most one real Hammer near defeat when it helps an unfinished objective.

changes.title: Track emergency booster impact without altering gameplay
changes.detail: The optional balance report now compares paired baseline and Hammer-assisted outcomes, records actual uses and per-chapter results, and explicitly labels the hypothetical stock assumption.

changes.title: Verify sparse booster rules in optional tests
changes.detail: Added report-only tests for the Hammer target selection, late-use trigger, strict one-use limit, baseline preservation, and matched-seed report consistency without touching release-blocking suites.
